title: Implement Higgs Audio v3 TTS backend with MLX support

comments.author: home
comments.text: Implemented Higgs Audio v3 (bosonai/higgs-audio-v3-tts-4b) replacing the 440 Hz tone stub with real speech synthesis via mlx-audio on Apple Silicon and transformers on AWS Batch GPU. Added BDD feature scenarios, unit tests, model license documentation, and website example page.
